summary: # Customize Avatar Hip Shape | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive ## Introduction Hey everyone, my name is Phoebe, and I'm going to go through our updates to our Avatar Editor with hip shaping. So let's dive on in and have some fun while we learn. ## Accessing the Avatar Editor Here we have an Avatar all set up. We've got our Avatar Editor window open here. Just as a reminder, you can find the Avatar Editor window at the very top part of the interface. Go to **Avatar** and then select **Avatar Editor**. This is where it will open up, and you'll find it. ## New Hip Shaping Feature What's really cool is we've added another option to shape. We previously introduced breast shaping, and now hip shaping has just been added in. ### Functionality of Hip Shaping So, what will the hip shaping do? It will allow you to control and adjust the hips right here. To give you a better way to view this, I'm going to actually adjust my low hip width. Let's set this to 39. #### Dips Adjustment Now, I'm going to show you what dips do. Dips adjust the inward or outward curve of the hip. If I go down, it will dip in, and if I go up, it will dip out. You can play around with this feature. #### Volume Control The other option you have here is **volume**. This controls more of the back part of the avatar. You can adjust the volume to make the back and bottom flatter or rounder. - If I decrease the volume, it will flatten, and the measurements will distribute so that the bottom drops a little more than stays up and curvy. - Conversely, if I increase this, it will move the measurements to curve upwards, creating a curvier shape. These options are all clearly labeled, so I don't know why I have to explain it so much, but essentially, you can choose between a flatter or curvier avatar. ## Creating a Realistic Avatar With these adjustments, you can create a much more realistic avatar that resembles a human form. You can see all the changes reflected right here. Pretty good, right? I'm going to make her curvier. Nice! ## Saving Your Avatar Once you're all done, you can just hit exit. This is your finished avatar, and you're all good to go. If I'm happy with how this avatar looks, I can go to **File**, select **Save As**, choose **Avatar**, and save this avatar out. All set! ## Conclusion Thank you so much for watching! If you have any questions, please use the comment section down below. Don't hesitate to share this video with your friends and family. I'll see you in the next one. Bye! ### Additional Resources Check out other videos; we've got a ton of them available on our Qlo YouTube channel. And again, thank you so much for watching. Don't forget to like and subscribe, and keep having fun in Qlo!
